summary: A cloneable, seasonal novelty riding Spotify Wrapped's brand, with no evidence of demand and no support for the $12–$25 per-group price. A new build also waits behind the distribution-first hold, and the December window is short.

demand.evidence: Only proof is Wrapped's reach (TechCrunch) and the existence of near-copies (Yapd, ZapZipped, WA Wrapped). No first-hand complaints found; Friend Wrapped has 2 ratings.

statusQuo.evidence: Chat-export wraps, polls and Etsy/eBay group gifts exist, but competitors give wraps away free and paid comparables are individual (~€6, $3.99/week).

specificity.evidence: 'Organizer of a friend group of 4-12' is a category; no named person or real consequence.

wedge.evidence: Invite link, 5 prompts, one AI award each ships in a weekend, but the paid HD unlock is a thin lever over a free preview.

futureFit.evidence: ChatGPT year-end review normalizes the format, platforms can add group versions, no moat, and demand collapses after December.

premises: Friend groups want a Wrapped of their own (unverified)
Friends will fill in prompts from the organizer's link (unproven, 10-40% from unrelated surveys)
An organizer will pay $12-$25 per group (unsupported; comparables are free or cheaper)
A 'make yours' credit creates a viral loop (guess)
A late-November launch is feasible (technically yes, window is about 3-4 weeks)
alternatives: Minimal: free-only page with no payments, to test completion only
Ideal: full product with story renders, yearbook, Stripe and deletion job on a commercial-use host
Extend tiebreak (David's viral poll idea, the growth focus) with an award-per-person feature
Lateral: sell a prompt template pack on Etsy to test willingness to pay at $0 build cost
wedge: A page where the organizer pastes 3-8 friends' answers collected by hand and gets one text award per friend. No link flow, no payments.

feasibility.notes: Next.js on Vercel Hobby, Supabase free, free model via LiteLLM. Taking payments (M4) needs a commercial-use host, which Vercel Hobby doesn't allow. Test for M1: generate with 3 submissions returns exactly 3 awards; a malformed model response returns 502 and stores nothing.

risks: Seasonality: the earning window is about December
Unknown fill-in rate; awards go thin below 3 respondents
Content safety, photos and takedown burden for a solo operator
New builds are held until tiebreak has traction
killCriteria: Drop if after 14 days fewer than 50 visitors are judged, signup rate is under 5%, or no organizer says they'd pay when asked; also drop if launch can't happen before about Dec 1.
